reason: This PR is concentrated in core SQL parsing paths (`parser.y`, lexer/keywords, generated parser) and also touches planner preprocessing for DDL. Even though the stated goal is compatibility for table options, keyword and grammar changes can have cross-statement blast radius, and `preprocess.go` means behavior is not purely syntactic. CREATE TABLE option handling is user-visible SQL semantics, so this is important and risky enough to justify a focused deep review for high-severity parser/planner regressions.
